title: eulophia walleri
intro: Eulophia walleri, commonly known as the Tiger Orchid or Cat's Whiskers, is a species of orchid native to tropical Africa. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, with its health benefits including the treatment of fever, malaria, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Eulophia walleri include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. These constituents contribute to the plant's ability to modulate immune response and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine.
